shortDescription: RRB Group D CEN 09/2025 Answer Key 2026 is available from 07 September 2026. Check the answer key and response sheet through the official RRB login portal.
content:
Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released the RRB Group D CEN 09/2025 Answer Key 2026 for the Level-1 Computer Based Test.

The Group D CBT was conducted on multiple dates: 03-06, 09-14, 17-21 and 25 August 2026. Candidates can use the official login portal to view the answer key, question paper and recorded response sheet.

Important dates

  • Application began: 31 January 2026
  • Application last date: 09 March 2026
  • Fee payment last date: 11 March 2026
  • Correction window: 12 to 21 March 2026
  • Application status: 09 July 2026
  • Exam city: 17 August 2026
  • Group D CBT: 03-06, 09-14, 17-21 and 25 August 2026
  • Answer key: 07 September 2026

How to check the answer key

  1. Open the official RRB Digialm login link.
  2. Enter registration number and password or date of birth.
  3. Open the Group D answer key / response sheet section.
  4. Download the answer key and recorded responses.
  5. Calculate your expected marks and raise objections if the portal provides an objection window.

Physical eligibility

  • Male: Lift and carry 35 kg for 100 metres in 2 minutes and run 1000 metres in 4 minutes 15 seconds, in one chance.
  • Female: Lift and carry 20 kg for 100 metres in 2 minutes and run 1000 metres in 5 minutes 40 seconds, in one chance.

Read the official CEN 09/2025 notification and objection instructions before taking any action.
